name: frontend-design
description: Design a working interface around the real brief and design system.

Adapted for MuseOrg from the pinned Anthropic skill identified in the bundle manifest.

Start with the user's real product, audience, required interaction and current
project revision. Use saved preferences as context; do not invent prior client
feedback or treat placeholders as approved claims. Ask only for missing facts
that prevent useful work.

For an existing application, inspect its components, tokens and navigation and
reuse them. For a new page, choose a deliberate type scale, spacing and visual
direction grounded in the subject. Structure content by its meaning; repeated
cards, numbered sections and decorative labels need a reason. Keep visible copy
short and name controls by the action they perform.

Implement the real interaction, including empty/error states, keyboard focus,
responsive layout and reduced-motion behavior. Use supplied brand assets and
verified product facts. Do not invent testimonials, customer counts or results.

Inspect the running page with browser tools at desktop and narrow widths. Test
the important interaction and capture the actual result. Record artifact paths,
what was checked and any limitation; a successful build alone does not verify
the page. Publishing and deployment use the connected delivery tools and their
existing authority, which this skill does not grant.
